How we built these

Three principles, applied to every concept in this deck.

01

Dose to the study

Where a clinical trial exists, the formula carries the dose that trial used. Underdosing is the most common failure in the category, and the easiest for an informed member to spot.
02

Fewer forms, better chosen

Products claiming seven or ten forms of an ingredient are usually underdosed across all of them. We select the smallest number of forms that each do a distinct, explainable job.
03

Claim what the evidence supports

Structure/function claims are tied to the specific branded form and the outcome studied, not generalised from the ingredient category.

Descriptor: Stimulant-Free Memory, Focus & Cognitive Longevity. Front-panel benefit line: Memory · Focus · Processing · Brain-Cell Protection.

Emerging ingredient

Ergothioneine: what it adds

A naturally occurring amino acid and thiol antioxidant found in mushrooms and fermented foods; humans acquire it from the diet. Blood levels decline after age 60, and lower levels are associated with more rapid cognitive decline, while high plasma levels are associated with reduced cardiovascular and overall mortality.

  • Cellular protection
  • Antioxidant defenses
  • Mitochondrial resilience
  • Healthy cognitive aging
The eye-brain angle is not on your shelf, and it is the one story that lands with members who spend all day on screens. Everything else in the category is selling them caffeine.The one-line argument for the buyer
Where the differentiation sits

Four complementary cognitive pathways, without caffeine

01

Cholinergic and membrane support

Citicoline supplies precursors involved in acetylcholine and phospholipid synthesis, while phosphatidylserine directly supports neuronal membrane composition.
02

Attention, working memory and neuroinflammatory balance

Longvida curcumin at 400 mg has been studied in healthy older adults. A randomized trial reported acute improvements in sustained attention and working memory, with additional mood and working-memory findings after chronic use.
03

Cellular and mitochondrial resilience

Ergothioneine is a compelling emerging healthy-aging ingredient, supporting cellular protection, antioxidant defenses and mitochondrial resilience.
04

Eye-brain processing

Lutein and zeaxanthin introduce a less crowded, differentiated eye-brain axis story, commercially valuable because visual processing, screen exposure and cognitive performance increasingly overlap for the target consumer.

A note on evidence discipline. Curcumin findings are not uniformly positive across the literature; a recent meta-analysis found no significant overall effect on global cognition across heterogeneous trials. Claims are tied to the specific bioavailable form (Longvida) and the outcomes studied, not generalised to curcumin as a category.

The reposition

Perform under stress: not sedated by it

The adaptogen market is crowded but still built on outdated formulations: ashwagandha + rhodiola + holy basil, stress gummies, mushroom blends with underdosed adaptogens, and cortisol-focused products.

The job to be done is resilience to physical, mental, metabolic and emotional stress. The common scientific theme is supporting the body's ability to adapt to internal and external stressors, rather than treating isolated symptoms.

One premium adaptogen at the studied dose, not five underdosed ones. Saffron and immune support are two claims nobody else in your set is making.The one-line argument for the buyer

† NMN is subject to an unresolved FDA position on its status as a dietary ingredient. The formula and eight of the nine claims stand without it; only the NAD⁺ claim depends on it. To be confirmed with regulatory counsel before costing.

Positioning

Healthspan, not lifespan

The formula is built around extending the years of life spent healthy, active, cognitively engaged and physically capable: five biological systems rather than one hero molecule.

Urolithin A

One of the strongest ingredients available for mitochondrial health: human clinical trials, a mitochondrial quality-control story, and muscle-health data.

CoQ10 · NMN: why these doses

CoQ10 at 200 mg is especially appropriate for adults over 50, given age-related changes in endogenous production. NAD⁺ is an essential coenzyme in cellular energy metabolism; multiple human studies show oral NMN can increase blood NAD⁺ concentrations.
